description: Flat knowledge files at db/ root. Projects/ may have folders.

ai_may_create.notes: New user projects MUST use create_project (Projects/<Name>/ with project.json + Files/). Nested files/folders are allowed only inside a project. Knowledge files at db/ root are host-seeded; SOI updates them via log_item.

file_roles.hayden.json: Who Hayden is. Sections characteristics, preferences, habits, values, desires, body, psychology are maps of name → [{time, text}, ...].
file_roles.people.json: People in Hayden's life. Top-level keys are names; each value is [{time, text}, ...]. Host creates a new name key when SOI logs a new person.
file_roles.questions.json: Topics Hayden has asked about. Top-level topic keys → observation lists.
file_roles.household.json: Home, pantry, repairs. Topic keys → observation lists. Fast decay.
file_roles.memories.json: Life events. Topic keys → observation lists. Slow decay.
file_roles.secrets.json: Private vault. Topic keys → observation lists. Strength decays; host never auto-deletes. Do not volunteer aloud.
file_roles.project.json: Named notes for one project under Projects/<Name>/. Extra keys besides version/name/summary are observation lists.

item_shape.key: person name, trait, or topic — a JSON object key whose value is an array
item_shape.entry: {time, text} appended each time the subject comes up
item_shape.strength: sum of linear remaining per observation (1 at time 0, 0 at lifetime). Host computed.
item_shape.resistance_days: lifetime used for that key: low_days at 1 mention, high_days at entrenched_count+
